parts.name: Mouth
parts.Basic_description: The mouth of the bottle is made of plastic and is located at the top, serving as the opening for pouring or drinking.
parts.Functional_description: It allows liquid to flow in or out of the bottle and can be sealed with a cap or stopper.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body is the main container portion of the bottle, made of plastic and shaped to hold liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid securely and provides structural integrity to the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move relative to other parts.

parts.name: Body Handle
parts.Basic_description: The body handle is a curved plastic component attached to the top of the bottle for carrying or holding.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a convenient grip for lifting, carrying, or pouring the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Body Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is another handle component of the bottle, made of plastic and designed for balanced handling.
parts.Functional_description: It assists in stabilizing the bottle when being carried or poured.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the body and does not move independently.
